Title: GitHub for AI Agent Memory Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
GitHub for AI Agent Memory. ## Shared, versioned memory for your agents and your team. Every AI agent starts a new session with no memory of what it did before. Connect your agents via MCP or SDK, and they get persistent, versioned memory across sessions. Invite teammates into a shared Room where agents from different users read and write the same memory, with full provenance on who knew what and when.
